creator: Claude Code (claude-opus-5-5) driving the owner's live Krita through the krita_mcp bridge
ownerDecision: Produced after the owner chose 'Override stop, draw all' (2026-10-24): full set with the code-drawn method, accepting below-master fidelity as a layout/scale placeholder set.
sourceMethod: Krita document at 4 px per world unit with two view groups (front, three-quarter facing right). Each view holds slot-ordered part groups (hair-back, arms with hands, legs/socks and shoes where visible, body-skin, outfit-bottom, outfit-top, head with ears, head-skin + clipped blush, face-eyes/*, face-brows/*, face-mouth/*, face-nose, hair-front), each with base, inherit-alpha clipped shade/light/details and a line layer. Shapes are hand-specified Bézier/Catmull-Rom paths drawn with QPainter; the ¾ view rotates facial features on a head sphere (25.8°) and compresses the far side of the body. Shading softened with Krita's Gaussian blur.
exportMethod: Each view/expression rendered at 4 px/u by toggling layer visibility (Krita exportImage, alpha), then downsampled with `sips -z` to @2x (2 px/u) and @1x (1 px/u). The hidden contact-shadow layer is not exported.
generativeModelUsed: No image-generation model. Shapes and colours were authored as code by the assistant.
reviewNotes: Below master fidelity (hair idiom, eye rendering, flat finish). Not on-model production art; not animation-ready.
